overview: The committee reviewed draft proposals for an overgrowth ordinance and updates to the city's rodent control ordinance. Both measures were forwarded for legal and departmental review while remaining in committee.

items.title: Overgrowth Ordinance (Paper 24-036)
items.summary: The committee discussed a draft ordinance to regulate vegetation obstructing public ways and creating rodent harborage, voting to add a definition for standing water and submit the text for legal review.

items.title: Rodent Control Ordinance Updates (Paper 24-461)
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed updates addressing residential regulations, tiered fines, pest management fees, and backyard composting standards, voting to incorporate staff feedback and send the draft for legal review.
